Subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake — audit window / what to share (options + quick templates)

Hi Michael / Acme security team,

Thanks for taking this request — we are kicking off a vendor assurance review for the Acme integration. To get us started we need the SOC 2 Type II report (or a redacted copy) that covers the most recent audit period, plus a bridge letter if the report's published date is outside our target window. A few clarifying asks so we can route internally: 

- Confirm the audit period covered by the report (start / end dates). If the report covers multiple periods, please state the specific control testing window.
- Do you have a bridge letter available that attests there were no material control changes since the report end date? If so, please share.
- If you prefer not to share the full report, a redacted PDF with an accompanying bridge letter + cover note is acceptable — we typically ask for: scope page, opinion, service auditor's testing period, and control exceptions (if any).
- Minimal artifacts we'd accept to close intake quickly: SYSTEM OVERVIEW (diagram), LOG RETENTION POLICY, ACCESS CONTROL POLICY excerpt, change management snapshot (last 90 days), and a sampling of telemetry/alerting evidence. 

Share options: S3 presigned upload, secure ShareFile, or a redacted PDF via email. If you want, we can provide an S3 presigned link and instructions (attached).

Attached: soc2_request_checklist.pdf (short checklist), presigned-upload-instructions.txt

Quick timeline: if you can confirm what you can provide by EOD Wed (2028-02-24), we will triage and ask only follow-ups as needed.

Below are two short reply templates you can copy if helpful — one for full report share and one for redacted share.

---
Template A — Full report
Hi Tessa,
We can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31. We will upload it to the presigned S3 link by 2028-02-24. No exceptions noted.
Regards,
Michael

Template B — Redacted + bridge letter
Hi Tessa,
We will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II (scope & opinion pages + any exceptions) plus a bridge letter confirming no material changes since the report date. Plan to upload by 2028-02-24.
Regards,
Michael
---

If you have any constraints on sharing, let us know what you can provide and we will accept a staged delivery (redacted first, full under NDA if needed).

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Compliance Ops | Redwood Inference

Tessa,

Thanks — we can help. A few quick clarifications from our side so we give exactly what you need:

1) Scope: The SOC 2 report covers our production environment only. Is that sufficient, or do you need staging/test control artifacts too?
2) Redaction: We prefer to share a redacted PDF publicly; for full reports we request a mutual NDA (standard).
3) Audit period: The Type II covers 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31; report issued 2028-01-15.
4) Bridge letter: We can provide a bridge letter — do you have a preferred template or language we should match?
5) Upload: Presigned S3 works. Please send instructions and an expiry window that works for you.

We can target 2028-02-24 for a redacted package + bridge letter; full report would need an NDA and an extra 3–5 business days.

Michael Sullivan

Looping in a couple of quick operational notes and a short set of one-line replies you can paste back — cuts down back-and-forth.

Operational suggestions:
- Offer redacted first then full under NDA. That gets the intake closed fast.
- Presigned S3: set expiry 7 days, max single file 1GB, provide S3 prefix with folder name "ACME-SOC2-2028".
- If they ask for precise artifact examples, provide a minimal list: scope page, auditor opinion, CC/Control exception table, data flow diagram (high-level), log retention policy excerpt, IAM roles snapshot, recent change control ticket export (last 90 days).

One-line reply snippets (feel free to send as-is):

Snippet — redacted + bridge: "Thanks Michael — redacted SOC 2 + bridge letter by 2028-02-24 works. Please upload to the S3 link we provide; we will follow up only for any missing items. — Tessa"

Snippet — need full w/ NDA: "Appreciate it — we can accept a full SOC 2 Type II under a mutual NDA. If you prefer, provide redacted material first and we will execute an NDA for the full report. — Tessa"

Bridge letter quick language (copy/paste):
"This letter confirms that, to the best of management's knowledge, there have been no material changes to the system and controls covered in the SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2027-12-31 through the date of this letter, except as noted here: [list any changes]."

If you want, I can draft a short intake email with the presigned link and the checklist attached — faster for compliance teams.

-ben
